item.text:
The cold climate air-source heat pump is **Upgrade 4 (04; `hvac_004`)**, as listed in the [ResStock 2025 Release 1 README](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf).

It is documented in **[ResStock Measure Documentation: Cold Climate Air-Source Heat Pump](https://research-hub.nlr.gov/en/publications/resstock-measure-documentation-cold-climate-air-source-heat-pump/)** by Philip White and Andrew Parker (2026), report **NLR/TP-5500-96413**.
